citations.quote: A derivative is a financial instrument that derives its performance from the performance of an underlying asset.
A derivative involves two parties agreeing to a future tranasaction. Its value depends on (or derives from) the values of other underlying variables.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: A derivative is a financial instrument whose value derives from an underlying asset. The four canonical types — forward, future, option, swap — divide on payoff shape (linear vs convex) and contractual venue (OTC vs exchange-traded), and supply the entry-point taxonomy refined by later 07 cards.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Derivative Anatomy and Instrument Types
